info.name: ESR Tank Management System
info.description:
## Complete API Test Suite — Full Automation

### Run Order (use Collection Runner)
1. Health Check
2. Authentication — registers users, auto-saves tokens
3. Tank Management — creates tank, auto-saves tankId
4. IoT Device — sends 3 live readings
5. Dashboard — verifies realtime data
6. Reports — daily / weekly / monthly
7. Error Cases — all negative scenarios
8. Cleanup — deletes test tank

### Environment Variables (auto-managed)
- `adminToken` — set after Login Admin
- `controlRoomToken` — set after Login Control Room
- `tankId` — set after Create Tank
- `deviceId` — set after Create Tank

### Quick Start
```
1. Import Collection
2. Import Environment
3. Select Environment
4. Click Run Collection
```
